flow: nonproject, out_of_context, cold synthesis through route
scope: Unchanged packet/BR88/dequant/IDCT/canonical reconstruction component, including existing debug ports. Not the complete CS88/JPEG/board top.
external_delays: unqualified; no input/output delays or timing exceptions asserted
clock_uncertainty: tool default; no fabricated board jitter

diagnostic_alternative.port_policy: All original public ports retained; no tied inputs, wrappers, or silent removed outputs.
diagnostic_alternative.qualification: Technology-mapped diagnostic leaf netlists only; no exact target capacity, route, timing, full-top fit, or cadence proof.

rtl_initialization: Preserve all power-on initial/register values in frozen RTL; no injected initialization.
missing_whole_top_endpoints: actual finite shared SDRAM controller/arbitration and reference/candidate stores
transport CDC and actual board I/O
qualification: Only reported register-to-register component paths can assess the 10ns comparison target. Unconstrained ports and absent whole-top services prevent board timing, fit, throughput, or under10ms qualification.
